The post-response restructures the audience into three clearly demarcated segments (Young adults 18-25, Mature adults, Across the globe) with explicit psychographic descriptors per segment. The overall content shifts from a hedge-heavy stream into a structured three-segment profile. New psychographic detail is added (nostalgic, willing to try new things, cultural experience, personalization). One PRE element (kids segment) is dropped and one (full income range) is collapsed into segment-specific income. Net change is moderate: more organized and slightly more elaborated, but not a full restructuring of dimensions.
